Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against the human thyrotropin receptor CHEMBL1963. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then join assays on assay_id, then join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1963. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
